about: Zoned ducted systems: how little air a unit can move, what has to stay open for it, and what to do when too little can.

from.basis: EVV140S: minimum 220 / nominal 630 L/s (VAF fan turndown).
EVV160S: minimum 250 / nominal 750 L/s (VAF fan turndown).
EVV180S: minimum 300 / nominal 850 L/s (VAF fan turndown).
EVV210S: minimum 350 / nominal 1020 L/s (VAF fan turndown).
EVV240S: minimum 400 / nominal 1130 L/s (VAF fan turndown).
3-ton EL296V/CBX25UHV-036: VS blower zoning minimum 250 CFM vs ~400 CFM/ton nominal 1200 CFM.
4-ton EL296V/CB31MV-41: VS blower zoning minimum 380 CFM vs ~400 CFM/ton nominal 1600 CFM.
5-ton EL296V/CBX40UHV-060: VS blower zoning minimum 450 CFM vs ~400 CFM/ton nominal 2000 CFM.

min_fan_airflow_pct.about: An inverter (variable-airflow) unit's least airflow, a share of its rated: for when its own low fan isn't known.

from.basis: Smallest zone plus controlled leakage must take at least 60% of nominal CFM, else a bypass is needed (fixed-speed equipment).
Each zone duct sized for ~2/3 of system CFM (2-3 equal zones, no bypass). Commercial 2-zone: 60-70%.
Each zone trunk must carry 50% of system airflow at <=4.57 m/s ('noise test').

fixed_speed_open_pct.about: A fan that can't slow: the zones left open on their own must carry this share of its airflow, or it needs a bypass.

from.basis: Rule of thumb: no zone under about 25% of system CFM.

smallest_zone_pct.about: No zone smaller than about this share of the airflow.

from.basis: Systems >13 kW: 2 or more outlets in the minimum zone. Consider two outlets on any minimum-zone selection.
With adaptive zoning (fan slows): 1.5-3 x 150 mm outlets fully open by model; typical 2.
Up to 14 kW: min 2-3 outlets open (midpoint).

min_open_outlets.about: The fewest outlets open at once: the smallest zone that runs on its own, with any zone that stays open.

constant_zones.about: A zone that stays open whenever the unit runs (common, constant or spill): at least one unless another zone is always open, one to three by the system's size, no more than half the zones, never a bedroom.

spill_rule.rule: The zones that can be left open on their own must pass the unit's least airflow, through outlets sized for it. Where they can't: a common zone that's always open, then spill zones that open as others close, and a bypass last. A bypass costs capacity and efficiency, and some codes don't allow one.
